summary: No reachable vulnerability. The change adds two bundled, authored JSON range files (heads-up.json, full-ring.json) imported statically and validated at module load by the existing parseDefaultRanges; the only widening is that referenceSize now accepts the three known sizes via Object.hasOwn on APPLICABLE_LINES (no prototype-key confusion), and unknown values are echoed truncated as before. rangesFor selects ranges from view.players.length (engine-produced, not user text) and returns null outside 2/6/8-10, keeping the existing all-unseen-combos fallback. The observed-stats snapshot path keeps its existing validation. No new dependency, no randomness, no I/O, secrets, shell, HTML or regex built from input; the package.json change only appends a test file to the opt-in test:slow script.
